depiction.primary_object: round analog clock face with two hands
modifiers: plus sign in upper right interrupting the circle
depiction.composition: single circular object, front view, with corner badge

readings.meaning: add time / log hours / timesheet entry
set new alarm / schedule new reminder

ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic clock or alarm icon at small sizes if the plus badge is overlooked.

modifier_semantics.meaning: add, log, extend, or create new time entry

task_intents: set a new alarm or timer
pick up an extra work shift
add extra screen time for kids

reasoning: Shows a clock face combined with a plus sign, clearly indicating adding time, logging hours, overtime, or requesting an extension. It fits tasks centered on timesheets, billing hours, extending parking or deadlines, and adding alarms, while remaining distinct from a plain clock.
